subject: Quick demo request from pricing CTA — aligning time windows

From: Samir Patel <samir@cobaltpay.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Interested — pricing CTA demo (budget intent)

Hi Laura,

I filled out the pricing page CTA this morning; CobaltPay is evaluating inference vendors for a customer-facing fraud scoring product. We have a mid-seven-figure budget range for PoC + production and are prioritizing latency and cost.

Quick ask: can we schedule a 30-min walkthrough of Redwood's pricing model + dedicated deployment options? Prefer PST mornings (8–11am) next week, but can be flexible. I attached a screenshot of our CTA submission.

High-level context: we expect ~1200 req/s at peak, 1–2s P95, and want private deployment options for PCI scope.

Thanks —
Samir
Head of Platform, CobaltPay
Attachments: pricing-cta-screenshot.png (image)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Interested — pricing CTA demo (budget intent)

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and context. Appreciate the sizing and SLA targets; that helps a lot.

I'm Laura on the Solutions side at Redwood. Happy to set up a 30-minute session to cover pricing, deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private), and a short Q&A on latency tradeoffs. Aditya (AE) is cc'd to join the commercial discussion.

Proposed 30-min windows (PST):
- Tue 6/22 9:00–9:30am
- Tue 6/22 10:30–11:00am
- Wed 6/23 8:30–9:00am

If none of those work, send over 2x windows that do — I can also share my booking link: https://redwood.app/booking/laura_bennett

One quick ask before we meet: could you confirm whether your PoC requires PCI-in-scope hardware (on-prem) or if a VPC/private cloud deployment suffices? We'll surface any compliance packaging during the call.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
